author: hanastolk
quote:
The world itself is good. However:

FRAMERATE & BUGS - the game is a unoptimized buggy mess. dipping below 30 FPS constantly in 2026 is not acceptable. not even san andreas dipped FPS. San andreas and the earlier GTAs were capped at 24, however the cap was due to hardware issues at the time, and there was little perceptible variation on framerate, which didnt affect gameplay much. That being said, there is absolutely no excuse for a game dipping FPS that much in 2026 besides bad optimization and lazy development. for a game of this budget and this much development time it is mind boggling that the performance is this crappy.

MAIN CHARACTERS - What in the hell is with the writing, the main characters are very unlikeable, Jason has no personality, and Lucia is so very much annoying. Differently from GTA V, i cant remember a single iconic moment of their interaction.

HISTORY - Most of the time i don't even care about the history, and just wanna go back to play the open world... you know, the thing that GTA is known for... im 10 hours in, and the story so crap that i dont really feel like going back to it. Not even worth mentioning the chores missions. like what the hell, who in their right mind is gonna want to replay getting groceries, buying flowers and fixing the guys house in a second or third playthrough. it gets so boring during the first one  that i really dont wanna do it again later. I played GTA V from start to finish multiple times (lost count), but can't see myself doing the same with this game.

MICROTRANSACTIONS - Yes.... in a single player game.... WHAT. That makes no sense at all.


whenever the online version releases, and is free from the bugs and crappy storyline, i may consider giving that a positive review. but as it is, i find it hard to recommend, even though the open world itself has a lot of potential
